title: Only one Bluetooth device for 'speak reading' ?
symptom: xDrip only allows one Bluetooth device to trigger 'speak readings' or vehicle mode, so when switching between multiple Bluetooth audio devices (e.g., car and work earbuds), the user must manually re-pair xDrip to the active device each time.
cause: The xDrip app only allows specifying one Bluetooth device (MAC address) to trigger vehicle mode or speak readings, rather than supporting a list of devices.
fix: Use an automation app like Tasker to create a profile that triggers 'speak readings' when any of multiple Bluetooth devices are connected, and turns it off when disconnected.
evidence_quote: As I said previously on this thread, you can easily use Tasker to be able to trigger multiple Bluetooth connections that you have. It is very simple to create a single profile to trigger any Bluetooth connection made. For instance, I have 3 sets of earbuds and a car listed to start "speak readings" whenever any one of them is connected, and turn off "speak readings" when they are disconnected.
